review_FsmConfig: review the Django AppConfig class FsmConfig that configures the FSM app
run_FsmConfig_ready: run the FsmConfig.ready method to import and register FSM state models and transitions on Django startup
review_annotation_transitions: review the annotation_transitions module imported by FsmConfig to register annotation state transitions
review_project_transitions: review the project_transitions module imported by FsmConfig to register project state transitions
review_task_transitions: review the task_transitions module imported by FsmConfig to register task state transitions
